contact.tagline: We Buy Industrial & Commercial Scrap Metal at Top Market Rates
contact.address: Dubai Industrial City, Phase 2, Dubai, UAE

services.title: We Buy Ferrous Metal Scrap
services.shortDesc: Immediate purchase of heavy melting steel (HMS 1 & 2), structural I-beams, factory rebar offcuts, plate cuttings, cast iron, and machinery frames.
services.description: We purchase all volumes of ferrous metal scrap directly from fabrication workshops, machine shops, construction contractors, and demolition sites. Full certified weighbridge receipts with direct mill pricing and zero middleman deductions.
services.highlight: Top cash & wire payout per metric ton with free collection.

services.title: We Buy Copper Wire & Tubing
services.shortDesc: Top-market rates paid for Bare Bright copper wire, Millberry copper, #1 & #2 copper tubing, armored power cables, and transformer windings.
services.description: Sell your copper scrap to certified buyers. Using handheld XRF elemental spectrometers, we grade copper purity on the spot, guaranteeing honest tare deductions and the highest daily payout in cash or instant bank transfer.
services.highlight: Instant XRF assay test with immediate payment.

services.title: Free Roll-Off Scrap Bin Placement
services.shortDesc: We drop off 10, 20, 30, and 40-yard heavy-duty steel scrap containers at your workshop or job site free of charge. Fill the bin, and we buy the metal.
services.description: Streamline your facility scrap management. When your scrap bin is full, call our dispatch hotline—we swap the container within 24 hours, weigh your scrap on certified scales, and settle your payment immediately.
services.highlight: Zero bin rental fees with scheduled or on-call collection.

services.title: Plant Decommissioning & Demolition Scrap Purchase
services.shortDesc: Complete scrap buyouts for retired manufacturing facilities, chillers, electrical switchgears, structural steel buildings, and industrial boilers.
services.description: Our certified dismantling crews manage turnkey salvage and removal. We purchase all recovered scrap metal on-site, providing crane mobilization, torch cutting, and full site clearance with environmental documentation.
services.highlight: Complete plant clearance with advance scrap deposit.

services.title: We Buy Aluminum & Stainless Steel
services.shortDesc: Purchasing 6063 clean aluminum extrusion, alloy wheels, sheet offcuts, CNC turnings, and grades 304, 316, and 310 stainless steel.
services.description: Turn your production offcuts and manufacturing scrap into steady cash flow. We accept both clean solids and unsegregated machine turnings, offering customized pickup schedules for CNC machine shops and extrusion plants.
services.highlight: Consistent high rates for industrial manufacturers.

services.title: We Buy Brass, Batteries & Automotive Scrap
services.shortDesc: Purchasing yellow and red brass fixtures, bronze bushings, industrial lead-acid batteries, automotive engines, transmissions, and catalytic converters.
services.description: We purchase commercial batches of scrap automotive parts, heavy equipment batteries, and brass plumbing scrap. Certified depollution and recycling documentation provided for all industrial clients.
services.highlight: Certified scale weighing and immediate bank wire.

blogs.title: How Machine Shops Can Maximize Revenue Selling Scrap Metal
blogs.excerpt: Learn practical segregation protocols for copper, aluminum, and stainless steel chips to avoid scrap buyer discounts.
blogs.content: For fabrication workshops and CNC machine plants, scrap metal is a significant revenue stream. Segregating high-grade solids from turnings and avoiding oil contamination can boost your scrap payouts by up to 35%. Learn our certified grading tips.
blogs.author: Marcus Vance, Senior Scrap Appraiser

blogs.title: Current Market Trends: What Scrap Buyers Look for in Copper & Brass
blogs.excerpt: Global infrastructure demand continues to drive premium rates for Millberry copper, clean tubing, and red brass valves.
blogs.content: Selling your copper scrap at the right time requires understanding international COMEX and LME trends. Discover why Bare Bright copper commands the highest premium and how our on-site XRF testing guarantees accurate payouts.
blogs.author: Elena Rostova, Chief Metal Buyer

blogs.title: Complete Guide to Selling Demolition Scrap & Heavy Melting Steel
blogs.excerpt: From structural I-beams to rebar bundles: how to prepare demolition metal for maximum tonnage payout.
blogs.content: Demolition projects generate massive volumes of heavy melting steel (HMS 1 & 2). Learn how our on-site mobile shearing, magnetic crane loading, and roll-off scrap bin logistics make selling demolition metal fast, safe, and highly profitable.
blogs.author: David Chen, Yard Operations Director
